title: 1790 Oran earthquake
summary:
The English Wikipedia article "1790 Oran earthquake", at revision 1373116857, opens: "The 1790 Oran earthquake occurred on 10 October, striking near the coastal city of Oran in Algeria. The earthquake had an evaluated maximum seismic intensity of VIII–X on the European macroseismic scale (EMS-98). An estimated 3,000 people died during the earthquake and accompanying tsunami. 
The magnitude of this earthquake has been disputed among members of the paleoseismology field, with estimates ranging from 7.5 to even as small as 5.5." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q109229623, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "seismic event in Algeria". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
